visualCharacteristics.summary: Rounded media cards that pin and stack over each other while scrolling, centred caption with accent phrase, no arrows or dots

contentPattern.summary: 3 sticky stacked autoplay video cards, each with caption: 'It's the roar of the crowd.', 'It's the heat of the summer.', 'It's the pulse of the city.'
contentPattern.structure: cell 1 = link to the video (any link is treated as a video, e.g. extension-less storage URLs) or a picture; cell 2 = caption paragraph, accent phrase in <em>

usage: Scroll-told sequence: each card pins (position: sticky) for one viewport and the next card slides over it. Only the front card video plays. No arrows or dots. Reduced motion: cards stack statically with video controls.
